notes: Agent Forge: the Academy now trains agents by itself. Press Train it for me and it plans a learning path for the role, researches each topic on the web, studies that with your files, then writes its own exams from your documents and takes them. Agents also study zips of past projects and learn the look of your artwork (palette, sizes, pixel art). Launch a forged agent in any project, or keep one always on. Fixes: the Forge and Mission Control headers no longer sit under the window buttons; a crisper LATYS logo; PDF text keeps its line breaks. New tour chapter: The Agent Forge.
